checks.reason: Temporary managed-browser fixtures resolved the canonical path, layout, mode, uid/gid, and SHA-256; same-name external selection was rejected.
Outside paths, escaping symlinks, globs, newlines, profile-language injection, shell-like arguments, and unsafe profile directories were rejected; spaces were quoted as data.
A deliberate executable mutation changed the measured digest and caused identity revalidation to fail closed; full-Chrome/headless-shell mismatch was rejected.
Generated output had a run-specific profile name, exact attachment, flags=(unconfined), userns rule, and no wildcard or appended policy.
The policy context guard rejects non-opted-in, non-dispatch, non-hosted, wrong-repository, and identity-mismatched contexts; probe construction is unprivileged.
Decision fixtures distinguish an already-positive sandbox, an attributable policy block, and an unrelated executable/dependency failure without installing a fallback policy.
Existing profile paths are refused; partial install ownership records creation/load separately and never claim a failed install loaded.
Cleanup decisions remove only run-created unchanged files, preserve mutated/unowned files, and report an absent resource as harmlessly already removed.
Fake launch evidence proves requested, rendered/launched, and observed states are separate; positive observation requires diagnostic or renderer namespace/seccomp evidence.
Coordinator, host gated checks, lifecycle, and Playwright configuration retain sandbox=true; host callers use the qualified managed path and the container worker uses its image-local managed browser.
All twelve R5 proof-directory ownership cases and the new workflow-boundary assertions passed; the helper does not create the coordinator proof root.
Nullable not-invoked proof exits, proof exits 1/2, sandbox prerequisite blocks, cleanup failures, and primary-versus-secondary failure ordering passed regression tests.
Node/pnpm/Playwright, lockfile, native manifest, application pins, Docker/Compose defaults, original gates, and deferred scope remain unchanged; no bypass or provider work was added.
T6 committed checks passed syntax, pnpm test:ci, focused regressions, lint, typecheck, build, unit, security, and diff checks with nonzero test counts.
No approved GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner was available to measure the default pinned Chromium failure/success or run the permitted AppArmor route; local Debian facts are not hosted evidence.
No hosted policy was installed locally; parser removal and post-cleanup global-policy measurements require the fresh router-dispatched hosted run.
Docker/Compose is absent on the editing host, so the shipped non-root worker browser and its unchanged container security options were not executed.
The one fresh local bounded proof exited 2 with 4 PASS / 0 FAIL / 68 NOT_RUN; no browser, Docker, loopback, application, ZIP, screenshot, or lifecycle assertions ran.
This editing box did not publish or dispatch a workflow and has no fresh hosted artifact to retrieve or verify.

The r6 handoff and root state preserve historical evidence, awaiting_review, application_acceptance=false, accepted version none, and the strict-versus-bounded distinction; hosted publication remains pending.

hosted_run_reason: Router publication and fresh standard GitHub-hosted dispatch were intentionally not performed by Luna.
